answer.value: Multimodal MoE with 552B backbone parameters and up to 1M-token context. Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED): 40-layer Transformer (20-layer causal encoder + 20-layer decoder), with the decoder's global KV cache projected from final encoder hidden states, so only 8B parameters are active per token in prefill and 16B in decode (improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads). SWA Bounded Replay reduces persistent KV cache to ~1/8 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. CSA2 assigns each attention layer a Full, Reindex, or Reuse mode to share main KV and indexer K and reuse Top-K indices; a Hierarchical Sparse Indexer bounds deeper indexer cost independently of context length; with FP4 main KV caching, global KV cache is 890 bytes per token (~1/4 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash). Uses 1 shared expert and 384 routed experts per MoE layer, activating 6 routed experts per token.
quotes: We introduce **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash adopts a **Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED)** architecture: a 40-layer Transformer organized as a 20-layer causal encoder followed by a 20-layer decoder.
This allows the model to activate only **8B parameters per token during prefill** and **16B during decode**, substantially improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads.

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses CSA2, which assigns each attention layer one of three static modes — **Full**, **Reindex**, or **Reuse** — to share main KV and indexer K across layers and reuse Top-K sparse-attention indices.
The model uses 1 shared expert and 384 routed experts per MoE layer, activating 6 routed experts per token.
